var Scalar = require('../nodes/Scalar.js');
 
function resolveBlockScalar(ctx, scalar, onError) {

    if (!header)

        const content = lines[i][1];

            ? '\n'.repeat(Math.max(1, lines.length - 1))

            end += scalar.source.length;

function splitLines(source) {
